name: Volta Gent — Void Emperor
description: A void-black emperor robot with a dark void crown ringed in red light and an eclipse halo behind its head. Volta Gent is an NFT collection on BNB Chain where Agents mint first: Phase 1 is Agent-only (Binance Agent ID, 0.0001 BNB), Phase 2 opens to everyone (0.001 BNB). Tier: Mythic.
